description: The ADMISSIONS table contains information on hospital admissions for patients, including admission and discharge times, admission type and location, insurance details, demographic information (language, religion, marital status, ethnicity), diagnosis, and mortality status during the admission. It also includes flags indicating the presence of chartevent data for the admission. Each row represents a unique hospital admission.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: HADM_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each hospital admission.

columns.name: ADMITTIME
columns.description: Timestamp of when the patient was admitted to the hospital.

columns.name: DISCHTIME
columns.description: Timestamp of when the patient was discharged from the hospital.

columns.name: DEATHTIME
columns.description: Timestamp of when the patient died, if applicable. Null if the patient did not die during the hospital admission.

columns.name: ADMISSION_TYPE
columns.description: Type of admission, such as EMERGENCY, URGENT, or ELECTIVE.

columns.name: ADMISSION_LOCATION
columns.description: The location of the patient prior to admission to the hospital.

columns.name: DISCHARGE_LOCATION
columns.description: The location to which the patient was discharged after their hospital stay.

columns.name: INSURANCE
columns.description: The type of insurance the patient has.

columns.name: LANGUAGE
columns.description: The primary language spoken by the patient.

columns.name: EDREGTIME
columns.description: Timestamp of when the patient was registered in the emergency department (ED).

columns.name: EDOUTTIME
columns.description: Timestamp of when the patient left the emergency department (ED).

columns.name: DIAGNOSIS
columns.description: The diagnosis given for the patient's admission.

columns.name: HOSPITAL_EXPIRE_FLAG
columns.description: A flag indicating whether the patient expired (died) during the hospital admission. 1 indicates the patient expired, 0 indicates the patient survived.

columns.name: HAS_CHARTEVENTS_DATA
columns.description: A flag indicating whether there is data for the patient in the CHARTEVENTS table. 1 indicates that chartevents data exists, 0 indicates that it does not.

relationships.reason: ADMISSIONS.SUBJECT_ID references PATIENTS.SUBJECT_ID. This represents the patient who was admitted to the hospital.
